I VOTED! 🗳️

Today, I made my voice heard because it is officially time for change.

If you are tired of the playbook of the past two years, we have to use our power at the ballot box. We cannot afford two more years of never-ending overseas military conflicts leading to insane cost increases in necessities, tariff wars with our closest allies that Americans pay for every day, rewarding billionaires & the fossil fuel industry with tax breaks while cutting food assistance programs for kids, medicare coverage - so over 11 million Americans lost their health insurance, or undermining our health system to the point where we are dealing with preventable epidemics like measles that were eliminated decades ago.

Our leadership should be focused on the future of every citizen, and stop letting a checked-out octogenarian continue to focus on gold-leafing everything in our nation’s capital or shifting daylight savings just to get more time on the golf course while our kids are forced to walk to school in the pitch black.

Democracy isn’t a spectator sport. If you want change, you have to vote for it. Drop a 🗳️ or ❤️ if you’ve already turned in your ballot, or let me know your plan to get to the polls!

We cannot afford to go through two more years of whatever this is...

#bluetseunami #TimeForChange #Vote2026 #YourVoiceYourVote #ElectionDay 
_

#HeyBangor Election Day is fast approaching and don't forget that if you need a lift to the polls, the Community Connector is available to you. The Community Connector is offering free fare -- yes, free -- on Election Day for ADA paratransit and fixed route service.

Election Day is next Tuesday, Nov. 3, and all voting will be done at the Cross Insurance Center, 515 Main St. in Bangor. 

Head over to this page for details on the Connector and its routes: https://www.bangormaine.gov/634/Community-Connector

item.caption:
🎃☀️ DAVIE COUNTY | YOUR NEXT FIVE DAYS!

Halloween, the time change, and Election Day are all in our latest forecast!

Here's what I'm expecting:

☀️ FRI 10/30: Mostly sunny | 81°/49° | 0%

🎃 SAT 10/31: Sun, then clouds | 67°/47° | 10%

🌤️ SUN 11/1: Partly sunny | 65°/49° | 10%

☁️ MON 11/2: Mostly cloudy | 68°/46° | 20%

🇺🇸 TUE 11/3 — ELECTION DAY: Partly sunny | 72°/49° | 20%

🎃 HALLOWEEN: Cooler, with increasing clouds, but trick-or-treating looks mainly dry!

⏰ SUNDAY: Turn those clocks BACK one hour as Daylight Saving Time ends!

🗳️ ELECTION DAY: A cool morning followed by a pleasant afternoon. Widespread rain isn't expected.

Friday's 81° warmth won't last, but we've got some pretty nice weather ahead across Mocksville, Advance, Bermuda Run, Cooleemee, and the rest of Davie County!

💬 Are you ready for cooler fall weather?

Rowan County Weather & Regional Forecast

#DavieCounty #MocksvilleNC #AdvanceNC #BermudaRun #Cooleemee #Halloween2026 #ElectionDay #NCWeather #RowanCountyWeather

I went out and cast my vote today because I refuse to sit back and complain about things that affect our everyday lives without making my voice heard!

We’re talking about the cost of living, affordable housing, healthcare, education, and the future of our children! These are REAL issues affecting REAL families every single day!

I don’t care who you vote for, but PLEASE educate yourself, know what’s on your ballot, and make your voice count! Your vote is your voice, and your voice MATTERS! 🗣️

We DID MY PART TODAY! 🗳️❤️🤍💙

item.authorHandle: cbsnews
item.caption:
Nicki Minaj pledged her continued support for Donald Trump at a rally in Michigan on Sunday, urging voters to back Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections.

“I will continue to support you forever and ever. If you run again, I will support you again,” said Minaj, who has become an increasingly vocal supporter of Trump.

author: mehlomakulur5

item.authorHandle: mehlomakulur5
item.caption:
🗳️VOTING STATIONS ARE FOR VOTING, NOT CAMPAIGNING

On Election Day, political candidates, party leaders, and party agents are strictly prohibited from wearing political party regalia inside voting stations. 

Why? 
Because a voting station must provide a neutral environment where every voter can make their choice freely, without being influenced, pressured, or intimidated. 

What about voters? 
As a voter, you have the right to wear your party regalia to vote. However, no active campaigning, rallying, or distribution of party materials is allowed by anyone within the voting station boundaries.

When you arrive, the focus should remain entirely on your right to cast your ballot freely and in secret.

author: b_the_pal

item.authorHandle: b_the_pal
item.caption:
Happy 250!!! 🇺🇸

It's a privilege to be able to vote in a time like this. I'm truly grateful for the education institutions, government, and society that brought me here, and thus, I'm voting to improve upon these very systems. In seemingly hopeless times like these, you (yes, you) have the power to make a change. Even if you can't vote, organize with like-minded neighbors, engage in civic discussions with others, and partner with organizations that tackle issues you care about.

I've often heard Gen Z is the future, but why not the present? Why should we wait for change to come when it's right at our fingertips? That is why I vote. #america250 #midterms #ivoted 

(P.S. @hallieshoffner we love you)
